mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet ( pet_idx, mem_idx, pet_name, pet_species, pet_gender, pet_breed, pet_age, pet_bday, is_primary ) VALUES ( seq_pet_idx.nextval, #{mem_idx}, #{pet_name}, #{pet_species}, #{pet_gender}, #{pet_breed}, #{pet_age}, #{pet_bday}, #{is_primary} )
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET pet_name = #{pet_name}, pet_species = #{pet_species}, pet_gender = #{pet_gender}, pet_breed = #{pet_breed}, pet_age = #{pet_age}, pet_bday = #{pet_bday}, is_primary = #{is_primary} WHERE pet_idx = #{pet_idx}

UPDATE pet SET is_primary = 'N' WHERE mem_idx = (SELECT mem_idx FROM pet WHERE pet_idx = #{pet_idx});
UPDATE pet SET is_primary = 'Y' WHERE pet_idx = #{pet_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE mem_idx = #{mem_idx} AND is_primary = 'Y' ORDER BY pet_idx DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
